question: With genuine Registry held fixed, is registering the same state-changed and selection-changed listener families used by the #415 construction sufficient to make labelled Inkscape object paths defunct or reincarnate across Layers/Objects close-reopen?
decision: REJECT_LISTENER_REGISTRATION_ALONE_AS_DEFUNCT_CAUSE_SCOPED iff all six finish with Registry owner, listener arm has exactly two successful registrations, both arms preserve readable A/B old paths while panel closed and rediscover identical A/B paths/names after reopen; otherwise HOLD
